assets.edition: United States, original K-A, NUS-NSME, copyright 1996
limitations: All six face layouts verified. Top, bottom and right derive from underexposed specimen photographs. No high-resolution flat scan of those faces found.
Front 1044×732 is softer than the 4170×2916 rear. Rectification and enlargement do not add print detail.

assets.edition: United States, early round seal, no REV-A, five-screw-era hangtab box
limitations: All six face layouts verified. Original front is approximately 590×840 effective pixels; thin edges are optically soft.
Source photographs have warm lighting and wear. Black-field repair is local; no new glyphs, stars or character art are drawn.
Clean Nintendo/MarioWiki REV-A front was rejected because it does not match the requested early box.

assets.edition: United States, black label, SNS P MW, copyright 1992
limitations: All six face layouts verified. Front is a 2460×1716 scan; remaining faces derive from original specimen photographs.
Complementary edge photographs retain the original typography and character poses. The top has shell-riding Mario; bottom has caped Mario.
Rear has creases near its upper screenshots; fine print and screenshot detail are limited by the photograph.

assets.edition: European Mega Drive, cream/pink grid, 670-1470-50S, copyright 1991
limitations: Complete outer wrap; no evidence of printed reverse-side wrap. Multilingual English-first rear is authentic to this edition.
Small dust and spine fold marks in scan require conservative local repair.

assets.edition: United States, SCUS-94900, original black label K-A, standard clear-tray jewel case
limitations: Complete four-part paper print set, including both rear spines. Mild edge wear.

Clear tray verified by a physical US specimen with matching disc code. Case envelope uses midpoints of CMC assembly inspection ranges (142.35 × 124.75 × 10.4 mm); fine molding is approximate, and CMC is not established as the original Sony case supplier. See docs/playstation-box-reference-evidence.json.
